site_name: Hertford Lock House, 201 Parnell Road and 199 Pamell Road, London, E3
description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/21/00956, Dated 13/07/2021.Non Material amendment(s) Sought to approved scheme to allow for the replacement of the existing external door with an equivalent timber door. The proposed door will retain the same overall dimensions, position, opening, and architectural style as the approved door shown on the submitted drawings of the original application. The proposed door will be constructed in solid timber, with a single vertical glazed panel replacing the previously approved multi-pane glazed arrangement. The colour, finish, and detailing of the proposed door will match the approved RAL colour and style used for the doors and windows throughout the building. No changes are proposed to the door opening, frame dimensions, sill, or surrounding fabric.
